//notes: Each value is the MAX acceptable lava/node wall-time ratio (lava is allowed to be up to Nx Node's time). A benchmark with no entry here is report-only (never fails the gate). Calibrated 2026-07-11 against the perf/buffer tip (observed ratio x ~1.5-2 headroom for CI noise); re-run `make bench` and tighten further as the ratios improve.

caps.//encoding: Added 2026-07-27 with bench/micro/encoding.js; decode-win1252 and decode-utf8-stream widened 2026-07-28 after they tripped on machine noise alone (typical 10.2x / 13.7x, observed 12.9x / 18.4x on a loaded box, while a paired A/B of the same two builds showed 0.995x). Note the tension: with ~1.27x run-to-run noise a ratio cap cannot reliably catch the ~1.43x regression these were written for — the cap is a coarse backstop, the real guard is a paired per-process A/B against the previous build. The absolute ratios are high because everything except decode-utf8-fastpath is a pure-JS codec against Node's native ICU/C++ one; the caps exist to catch a REGRESSION, not to claim parity. Headroom is ~1.4x of observed rather than the 1.5-2x above, because the regression these are here to catch (a per-code-unit wrapper on the accumulator) measured 1.43x and must trip the gate.
